stem: Damian needs a stronger closing for his paper. Which sentences should he add after sentence 28 to bring his paper to a more effective conclusion?

options.label: F
options.text: You must be the one who changes this. It isn’t fair to make others think they have all the rights.

options.label: G
options.text: Don’t be lazy. Get off the couch and do something that matters.

options.label: H
options.text: When Election Day comes, go to the polls and cast your vote. It’s not only your right but also your responsibility.

options.label: J
options.text: You’ll feel better if you persuade people to vote. You can help make your community more vibrant.
